title: Convolution algebra of maps from a coalgebra to an algebra
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $C$ an $R$-module with $R$-linear maps $\Delta:C\to C\otimes_R C$ and $\epsilon:C\to R$ satisfying coassociativity and both counit identities, and $B$ an associative unital $R$-algebra (not necessarily commutative). Use tensor products [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Then $\operatorname{Hom}_R(C,B)$, with its usual addition and scalar multiplication, is an associative unital $R$-algebra for convolution $f*g=\mu_B\circ(f\otimes g)\circ\Delta$, where $\mu_B(b\otimes b\prime)=bb\prime$. Its unit is $c\mapsto\epsilon(c)1_B$ and its scalar map is $r\mapsto(c\mapsto r\epsilon(c)1_B)$. No finiteness or cocommutativity of $C$ is assumed.
